--- Authorship.md ---
The `-- @name` notation | Signing your own text
Rather than typing the notation by hand, run `Mention: Sign` (or the `/sign` slash command) to append `-- @you` to the end of the current block. This is what lets a person answer a mention without re-queuing the reply in their own inbox: signing a reply attributes it, it does not address it, so it never becomes a fresh request to yourself.

--- Guide/Comments, Mentions and Replies.md ---
Add a comment | Find and answer it
1. Run `Navigate: Mentions`, or click a mention to open the _Mention Inbox_.
2. Select the recipient from the dropdown. The inbox normally starts with your own identity and groups entries by page.
3. Open the request and write the answer underneath. Mention the original writer if the reply should appear in their inbox:

```markdown
@author This section is ready for review. -- @reviewer
```

Use `Mention: Sign` or `/sign` to sign the current block as yourself. Signing alone credits the reply.

--- Recipient.md ---
The Mention Inbox
A **recipient** is an [[Identity]] you address. When mentioned with `@name`, it is indexed to be queried, and clicking it in the editor will open the “Mentions Inbox”.

See [[At-Mention]] for the `@name` syntax, and [[Identity]] for where names come from (accounts, `identity.define`, or simply being mentioned).

The Mention Inbox | The Mention Inbox
The Mention Inbox is a [[View|view]] listing open `@mention`s, grouped by page. It opens in the right sidebar by default, and its dock menu can move it to the left sidebar, bottom panel, or a modal. Open it with `Navigate: Mentions`, or by clicking any mention.
